gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Noto Sans Mahajani reads modern and upright, its lowercase standing tall against the capitals while the e opens like a funnel. Warnes, glowing like bent neon glass, supplies the swagger.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-malayalam: Approachable is the first word for Noto Sans Malayalam, whose middle-heavy lines and generously opened s keep text friendly under Warnes, a bold display face with stretched tracking. Nudge the body size up a little.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: Warnes draws its heading in tube-like strokes that look like neon glass, tapering out before they touch, while Noto Sans Mandaic follows in curvy, unclamped lowercase. Give the body a modest size.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Noto Sans Marchen reads clean, with small letters standing almost capital-sized and curves that finish in clear daylight. Warnes brings lines like bent rope, and that tubing look is the pair's hook.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-mayan-numeral: Noto Sans Mayan Numerals has tall-bodied small letters and a visibly gaping c. Warnes above it draws every line with a ruler-straight, constant width, stretched out with spacious tracking, so a modest body size is plenty.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-medefaidrin: Noto Sans Medefaidrin reads contemporary, its lowercase rising high and its curves turning in without any ink pooling. Warnes is the one for loud display work, with its t crossbar matching its stem, and the body font handles quiet text.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-meetei-mayek: Warnes is all monoweight skeleton, ink strokes tapering out before they touch and spaced wide. Noto Sans Meetei Mayek sits next to it with large lowercase eyes and rounds that gap like a cracked bangle, a softer, more contemporary voice.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-mende-kikakui: Noto Sans Mende Kikakui reads modern and clean, showing daylight through every curved opening under tall lowercase. Warnes is best at bold display lines of uniform gauge, while the body font does the quiet work.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-meroitic: Approachable describes Noto Sans Meroitic, with see-through c openings and lowercase that fills the line like capitals. Shrink Warnes and its thick-only outline loses its glow, and a large body would crowd it.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-modi: Warnes draws strokes whose thickness never shifts with direction. Noto Sans Modi sits beneath it with daylight inside every curve, so the loud heading and the clean body each keep their own space.
